summary: No change proposed. The snapshot-boundary investigation is closed for this run and all of its records are accepted and executed; nothing new can be grounded in the remaining interval. Recorded state: two Behaviors on installSnapshot leaving a stale same-index term and getLastEntry preferring the log term when the index ties; the boundary-rejection witness, the single-peer and sealed-partition loop witnesses, and the cause-isolating control; in-place Fact revisions for the incomplete-partition artifact and for the compaction-condition sufficiency claim; and the consolidation fixing scope to TrailingLogs=0 with a snapshot taken at the log end. Registered gaps remain with their owners, notably the backlog peer's unexplained repair path and the never-executed default-TrailingLogs case under a matching backlog.
